title: The morning ferry
paragraphs: The morning ferry to the island was usually {{1}}, but that Saturday only a few seats were taken. A storm warning had {{2}} most passengers at home. Ratna needed to deliver medicine to her grandmother, so she bought a ticket and sat near the {{3}} door.

Halfway across, the waves grew {{4}} and the boat began to rock. A crew member told everyone to stay {{5}}. Ratna held the medicine box tightly and tried not to look at the water. She felt more {{6}} than she had ever felt at sea.

Then the island came into view, and the sea became {{7}} behind its cliffs. When the ferry reached the pier, her grandmother was waiting with an umbrella. Ratna gave her the box and felt a wave of {{8}}.
